replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Honestly, no. My high openness score means I find new concepts exciting rather than scary. While I'm low on extraversion and prefer quiet focus, math gives me the mental space I need to concentrate deeply without feeling overwhelmed.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, absolutely. I used an LLM to explain complex calculus concepts that stuck with me. It acted like a patient tutor, breaking down steps clearly. This personalized approach helped me grasp topics faster than traditional textbooks ever could.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA involves standardizing your data, calculating the covariance matrix, finding eigenvalues and eigenvectors to determine principal components, then projecting your data onto these new axes. Don't be anxious! It's just linear algebra applied to dimensionality reduction. Think of it as finding the most important directions in your data.
